tocfl-cert-2022.year_basis: Year encoded in official reference filenames.

tocfl-cert-2024.year_basis: Year encoded in official reference filename.

tocfl-cert-mock-current.year_basis: Stable rolling-bank identity anchored only to the official page's October 2025 update statement; not an administered-exam year.

adapter_gap.root_cause: The adapter assigns the process date to an undated rolling mock bank. Capture year 2026 is not an official resource year.

probe_policy.declared_scope: Every direct reference and downloadable mock-test asset on the official reference-download and mock-test pages. This excludes browser-only tests and is not an archive of every administered TOCFL sitting.

legal_and_technical.restriction: The mock page states that the materials are TOCFL copyrighted, for learning use, and not for commercial use; the footer reserves rights. No blanket GitHub redistribution grant was established.
legal_and_technical.robots_status: No machine-readable robots policy was found at the canonical host.

probe_policy.mock_page_statement: The official page says the 2,138-question bank was updated in October 2025 and that the rolling question-bank model began in 2024.

publication_risk.manifest_agreement_warning: URL agreement propagated the runtime year through raw, normalized, bundle, frontend, and release layers.
